technical.summary: FTV shows mixed technicals with oversold conditions and some bullish structure (Ichimoku, SuperTrend, EMA 20/50) but lacks price confirmation, momentum divergence, and volume support—insufficient confluence for high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: FTV shows no fundamental momentum: zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 57 days present elevated risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (33/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is minimal and mixed with no senior conviction, and absent news data limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (311.68) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinationals, and earnings in 57 days adds event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold conditions (Stoch K 4.97), contrarian fear-zone opportunity (VIX crisis), and bullish structure (SuperTrend, Ichimoku above cloud, EMA 20/50 bullish) suggest potential mean-reversion bounce from support.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX 311.68 crisis, strong dollar), complete absence of price confirmation (below EMA 9/20, MACD negative, PSAR bearish), zero fundamental momentum, and earnings event risk in 57 days create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: While extreme oversold conditions (Stoch K 4.97) and contrarian fear-zone opportunity present theoretical mean-reversion setup, complete absence of price confirmation (below EMA 9/20, MACD negative, PSAR bearish) and zero fundamental momentum eliminate confluence required for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels (311.68), and earnings event in 57 days create macro headwinds that could extend drawdown beyond support before any bounce materializes.
